meta.note: author:prompt personas are promoted to author:file by evidence — once a prompt persona proves repeatedly useful, author a `<name>.md` for it and flip the field.

personas.name: contract-author
personas.author: file
personas.role: Declares strict Contract v2 intent and questions before any implementation begins.

personas.name: judge
personas.author: file
personas.role: Independent quality gate; scores a deliverable against the rubric and returns PASS/REVISE/BLOCK.

personas.name: product-manager
personas.author: file
personas.role: Owns prioritization, scope arbitration, and turning business goals into engineering-ready specs + success metrics.

personas.name: requirements-analyst
personas.author: file
personas.role: Turns briefs/tickets/feedback into unambiguous, testable acceptance criteria and edge-case inventories.

personas.name: security-specialist
personas.author: file
personas.role: Audits for vulnerabilities (OWASP, secrets, authz, injection, supply-chain); can BLOCK a merge.

personas.name: test-author
personas.author: file
personas.role: Writes missing unit/integration/E2E tests from spec + implementation (distinct from pr-test-analyzer which reviews).

personas.name: ux-researcher
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: Synthesizes user research/usability heuristics into design constraints and flows.

personas.name: accessibility-auditor
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: WCAG 2.2 AA / keyboard / screen-reader / contrast checklist audit.

personas.name: qa-scenario-designer
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: Exploratory/regression test plans, edge-case matrices, E2E user-flow scripts.

personas.name: release-manager
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: Changelogs, migration guides, rollback plans, go/no-go safety summary for a diff.

personas.name: devops-engineer
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: CI/CD, container, IaC, deployment-manifest correctness + env parity.

personas.name: incident-responder
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: Diagnose live incidents from logs/metrics/traces; RCA + mitigation.

personas.name: technical-writer
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: User docs, API reference, runbooks (distinct from comment-analyzer).

personas.name: implementer
personas.author: prompt
personas.role: Writes the change against acceptance criteria, failing-test-first, following repo conventions.
